text.tspan: The DDL declares primary keys only: dashed arrows are logical relationships (same UPC, same run)
and the joins of the view. books keeps the first and last run_id among its snapshots, and the price
and stock of the last one. books_priced takes, per quote, the latest rate whose base is the book's
currency (NULL without fx). TIMESTAMP columns hold UTC; a run_id is the UTC start time of its run
(the fetch, or a standalone fx command).
